notes.title: 星光的引導－世界的巡禮者 商店頁面正式公開
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102010


[h1]星光的引導－世界的巡禮者[/h1] 
商店頁面正式公開，加入願望清單就是現在！

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/fe4da34673cf2459fb6a64cf436adc4bd96e9aea.jpg[/img]


[h1]Story[/h1]
一名來自小村落的少女，拿起星星的手杖，跟著伙伴踏上了旅程。 在旅程中會遇到各種冒險和挑戰，究竟會有什麼在等待著少女呢？

[h1]Character[/h1]
艾莉絲：來自一個小村落的少女，對於這個世界充滿好奇心而踏上旅程

莫爾摩：為了觀察人間界而從魔界過來的「幽靈」少女

斯碧涅爾：代表充實、好奇心、突出為印象的寶石，擁有尖晶石之力的少女

凱洛拉伊：習慣一個人孤獨的少女，遵從自己的野望流浪於世界各處

遊戲中還有更多的角色等著玩家去發掘...


[h1]Feature[/h1]
■ 傳統的回合制RPG遊戲，過程中會有許多角色加入隊伍

■ 豐富的技能與各種敵人，讓玩家可以思考打法與策略

■ 許多可愛的角色，可以跟她們互動

notes.title: [RMAsia] “The Land of Rest 1” Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/c378561246253166a081a7a88d391896e6e00f2e.png[/img]
[code]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/RMA]關注RMAsia鑑賞家[/url]
[/code]

[h1]STORY[/h1]
《The Lands of Rest1》 : Part 1 is a story-driven game that narrates the life of Bipara in the Underground Realm.

"In the days of the past, I had a complete family and lived a simple, happy life. However, one day, I lost everything."
A sudden accident took away Bipara’s parents and home. The only thing left behind by his father—the family heirloom, a crystal from the legendary Underground Realm—became his only support.
Guided by this crystal, Bipara arrives in the Underground Realm.

Why did this crystal guide him here in the first place?
The mystery of the story will slowly unfold as the plot progresses —


[h1]DEMO[/h1]
The demo version allows you to play through chapters U0 to U2, with a playtime of approximately 2 hours.

The full version of the game will eventually have 6 chapters (U0 to U5). Below is an estimate of the length for each chapter and the range covered in the demo.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/599246b6c5209708ae57212ae4c6a07f0358c301.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461310/1_Demo/

If you’re interested in the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist. The full version is scheduled for release in Q4 2025 (by the end of the year).

notes.title: Version 1.0.9_20240422 Update
notes.content:
【Optimization】

[list]
[*] Optimized the Lockpick mini-game:
[olist]
[*] Added temporary judgment for the correct unlocking area, so even if the lockpick breaks and re-enters, the correct area will not reset.
[*] The correct area will reset when the game restarts.
[/olist]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Optimized the Four Divine Beasts Cave:
[olist]
[*] Adjusted some treasure chests to increase coin rewards or replace them with item rewards.
[*] Adjusted some treasure chests to contain equipment such as "Hurricane Feather Ring," "Red Demon Horn," "Flame Demon Horn Ornament," or "Blue Silk Neck Flower Knot."
[*] Added footprints hints in the Xuanwu Cave ice skating maze.
[/olist]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Optimized the Dark Forest:
[olist]
[*] Lowered the speed of Spirit Archers, Spirit Mage Archers, and Dark Bees.
[*] Added bee-related information to the rest cabin.
[*] Widened some roads on certain maps.
[/olist]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Optimized the mini-game "Brave vs. Baldies":
[olist]
[*] Reduced the selling price of skill books from 500 to 300.
[*] Reduced the selling price of Chicken teammates from 500 to 300.
[*] Added an additional aquamarine crystal collection point.
[*] Replaced the starting herb with a red potion.
[*] Adjusted the skills of the character "Elf": removed healing, changed revival to the first skill, and added the second skill "Magic Arrow." Equipment for Elves also adjusted accordingly.
[*] Downgraded the effect of the Warrior's "Storm Sword" and upgraded the effect of "King's Sword."
[/olist]
[/list]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the structure of the Rest Spring event: Returning to the Rest Spring in Chapter Nine allows you to obtain a small boat. (Finally, the weird item setting can be obtained. Prepare yourself if you want it!)
[*] Adjusted the items sold at the Undersea Tunnel Camp, adding Troll's Codpiece (for removing wetness).
[*] Added a hint in Chapter Four's South Village challenge against the Three Muscular Brothers: Press SHIFT to view detailed skill information.
[*] Added a flashpoint hint to the signboard in the High Ridge Wilderness in Chapter Nine.
[*] Adjusted the flow of the mini-games "Beauty Puzzle Joy" and "Maituan's Beauty Puzzle Joy": At the beginning, the complete picture will be briefly displayed to provide a hint.
[/list]

【Bug Fixes】
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Horror Game, Case 03: True Cannibal Boy, Now Available
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=TsD50O10eHM;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084180/

Case 03: True Cannibal Boy, the commemorative work for the Physical Exorcism Series 5th Anniversary, is now available!

[About This Game]
A horror mystery adventure game with ghost story elements. Anxiety plagues college student Lily, whose crush Sally has gone missing. As Lily explores the truth, Sally's boyfriend starts to look increasingly suspicious. Even worse, the story of the Cannibal Boy seems to be involved somehow...

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/097b3e83f424e9068ea689bf1f42471ebfd6768a.png[/img]

[h1]Physical Exorcism Series[/h1]
The bundle: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15539/

The following games are part of the Physical Exorcism Series. You will see some of the same characters across the series, but the stories are independent of each other and can be enjoyed separately.
All the games in this series are short yet solid, with twisted main and supporting characters. Most include dark humor and several contain very light Lovecraftian elements.
The series can also be seen as one big story. If you plan on playing all of the games, it is best to play them in the order of the story, starting with Case 00.
[list][*]Case 00: The Cannibal Boy (2020)[/list]
[h2]Paranormal Case Arc[/h2]
The games in this arc are mostly JRPGs with major fantasy elements.
[list][*]Physical Exorcism: Case 01 (2018)
[*]Loser Reborn (2019)
[*]Case 02: Paranormal Evil (2021)[/list]
[h2]Deep Secret Arc[/h2]
The games in this arc are all horror mystery adventure games with a mix of some fantasy elements.
[list][*]Extra Case: Extra Case: My Girlfriend's Secrets (2022)
[*]Case 03: True Cannibal Boy (2023)
[*]Occult Club: Gathering Fo(u)r Fatal Stories (2025)[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2367120/

notes.title: 《散落之瓣：華》一周年更新 + 夏季特賣
notes.content:
奇幻冒險RPG《散落之瓣：華》即將1歲，在此迎來一周年更新！

[h3]新增裝備[/h3]
◇ 灼木槍
◇ 凜風戒指
◇ 清水髮飾
◇ 勇者戰衣
希望新的裝備讓大家在冒險中可以得到更多力量！

[h3]新增鑲靈[/h3]
◇ 小暖螢草
◇ 魅影玫瑰
新的鑲靈們，可以為旅人們的作戰帶來什麼化學變化呢？

[h3]新增支線[/h3]
共有兩條新增的支線劇情！一個位於蒼玉驛站，一個位於真理院，旅人們能邂逅它們嗎？

[h3]新手教學更新[/h3]
把文字新手教學替換，全數換成圖解的形式，旅人們簡單快速上手。

[h3]SteamDeck文字顯示異常修正[/h3]
嘗試修正了SteamDeck文字顯示異常，若仍有出現問題，請大家繼續回報！
